title: fix(console, app-shell, plugin-detail): an approval request opens in the app that owns its record, and its record card opens the record
body:
Fixes #32667
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：审批请求从首页「待审批」、通知或审批收件箱打开时，进入「列出该记录对象的那个应用」（调用方应用列出它就留在原处，否则第一个列出它的应用，再否则 Setup）；请求页上的「记录」卡标题现在能点开记录；详情区点击复制在浏览器拒绝或无剪贴板时不再抛错；被驳回 / 退回 / 批准的请求在详情页顶部直接显示决定意见与决定人。
- **为什么改**：审批人落进无关应用的侧栏，申请人从被驳回的请求到不了要修改的记录，驳回理由只在「时间线」页签里。
- **风险与回滚**：只动 Console 前端，不碰服务端与 spec；深链接会多一次 `GET /approvals/requests/:id` 读取请求的对象名。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`（`RequestDeepLink` 与 `requestPagePath`）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/record-preview/record-pointer-card-renderer.tsx`（`OwnerAppRecordLinks`）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/objectHostApp.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：在 A 应用里从首页点一条属于 B 应用记录的待审批 → 地址栏应为 `/apps/APP_B/sys_approval_request/record/...`，B 的侧栏；点「记录」卡标题 → 打开该记录；驳回后申请人打开通知 → 详情页顶部看到「已驳回 · 审批人」与驳回意见。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **The request opens under the app that owns its record.** `requestPagePath` built `/apps/CALLER_APP/sys_approval_request/record/ID` from whichever app the request was opened from. It now takes the app segment from `objectHostAppSegment` (new, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/objectHostApp.ts`): the caller's app when its navigation lists the record's object (CONTROL), else the first app the user can open (`filterActiveApps`) that lists it, else Setup, else (no owner and no Setup the user can open) the caller's app, the one place it knows the user can reach.
   - Home's 「待审批」 row and every approval notification reach the request through the inbox deep link `/system/approvals?request=ID`, which names the request only. So the deep link now reads the request once (`approvalsApi.getRequest`) for its `object_name`, then redirects (still `replace`, so Back leaves the way the reader came). With an empty app catalog it reads nothing and keeps today's path. A failed read keeps the caller's app, where the record page says why it cannot load.
   - The inbox queue's row, mobile card and Enter open the request from the row they already hold, with no extra read.
   - Landing spot vs the claim: the Home and notification link builders under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/**` were NOT edited. Measured: both already funnel into the inbox deep link (`HomePage.tsx` `onOpenApproval`, and the server's `actionUrl` `/system/approvals?request=ID` hosted by `openInboxNotification`), so the producer to fix is the deep link's redirect, the one choke point.
2. **The record card opens the record.** Measured producer: `RecordPreviewCard` asks the page's `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` for the href, and the bridge's `appRecordPath` routes only objects in the route's object scope. A full-page record route's scope is the objects its page binds (the request and its timeline) plus, at most, the app's own package, so a pointer to any other object answered `null` and the title was plain text (in an unrelated app or in Setup always; pinned with the real `appRecordPath` + `routableObjectNames`). `record-pointer-card-renderer.tsx` now completes the host's builder for the pointer's own target only: the host's href wherever it has one, else the record route under `useObjectHostAppSegment` (the same resolution as item 1). The card itself is unchanged and still links only in its `readable` state.
3. **The copy never throws.** Measured thrower: not `RecordPreviewCard` but the details grid row around it, `DetailSection`'s `handleCopyField` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`), which called `navigator.clipboard.writeText(...).then(...)` with no rejection handler and no guard for a missing API. It now does nothing when there is no clipboard API, and swallows a refused write; the copied mark still shows only for a write that landed.
4. **The decision comment is where the applicant lands.** `ApprovalDecisionPanel` (above the tabs, on the Details view a notification opens) now draws the deciding action's comment and who recorded it, for `rejected` (`reject`), `returned` (`revise`) and `approved` (`approve`). The request row carries no comment, so it reads the request's thread the way the Timeline tab does: a `find` of `sys_approval_action` scoped `{ request_id }`, newest first, through the page's data source (the console routes it to `GET /approvals/requests/:id/actions`). Pending requests read nothing. Existing `approvalsInbox.act*` keys only, no new i18n key.

Not edited (the claim's exclusions hold): `chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`, `hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts`, `hooks/inboxArrivals.ts`, `hooks/useRecordApprovals.ts`, `context/*Preferences*`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, any server code.

## Tests

Measured red on `main` first (`8ce5827f9` + the new pins only), then green on the fix. Head of the final runs: `0dc819eda`.

- `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484.test.tsx` (real inbox + real `RecordDetailView` over the served page): the deep link lands under the owner app and replaces itself in history; a queue row opens under the owner app with no extra read; no app lists the object, so Setup; CONTROL: the caller's app lists it and the request stays there.
- `record-pointer-card-renderer.test.tsx`: the page's bridge cannot route to the record (real `appRecordPath`); the title links to and opens the record under the owner app; Setup fallback; CONTROL: the request page's app lists the object; CONTROL: a bridge that can route keeps its own href and `openRecord`.
- `DetailSection.copyObjectValues-8395.test.tsx`: a refused write leaves no unhandled rejection; no clipboard API throws nothing; CONTROL: a granted write still copies.
- `ApprovalDecisionPanel.test.tsx`: rejected and returned requests show the deciding comment and actor, from one scoped thread read; CONTROL: pending reads nothing; CONTROL: a comment-less rejection draws nothing. One existing CONTROL (decided request, no directory read) now allows exactly the thread read.
- `utils/__tests__/objectHostApp.test.ts`: each step of the order, deactivated/hidden apps, and the unloaded catalog.

<details><summary>Ablation: each pin is load-bearing (four legs over the committed fix, each restored and proven by an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit; marker count 1, anchor count 0 on disk). `@object-ui/*` resolves to `src` under vitest, so no `dist` leg applies.

- owner-app (`objectHostAppSegment` never picks an owner): 4 failed / 25 passed. The deep link, the queue row, the card's owner link and the helper's owner step go red; the Setup fallback and the CONTROLs stay green.
- card-link (the renderer no longer wraps under a router, and does wrap outside one): 8 failed / 4 passed. All 3 new owner-link pins go red, and the 5 router-less tests go red too, which shows the router guard is load-bearing as well. Direction: more red than the pins alone.
- copy-guard (the unguarded write restored): 2 failed / 18 passed. Both clipboard pins.
- decision-comment (the comment part removed from the panel): 4 failed / 20 passed. The 3 comment pins plus the adjusted CONTROL, whose single allowed read disappears.
</details>

Type-check: `@object-ui/app-shell` / `plugin-detail` / `console` `type-check` need every `@object-ui` dependency built to `dist` and could not run in this container. A source-mapped `tsc` over the changed app-shell and plugin-detail files and their tests (the `ui/tsconfig.json` paths) reported no error in them. The console file is NOT MEASURED locally; `Type Check UI` carries it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Member gates are not applied.** `objectHostAppSegment` reads each app's navigation as authored, without `useNavMemberGates`. An entry a `visible` expression hides from this member still makes its app the owner. The palette's private `appListsObject` / `recordHitAppSegment` (`chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`) apply the gates. That file is held by this seat's #32627, so it was not touched. Once #32627 lands, the palette's two private helpers can import `appListsObject` from `utils/objectHostApp.ts`, one copy instead of two (hunk: delete the palette's `appListsObject` and its `PaletteApp` navigation reading, import the shared one, keep its gates argument by filtering trees through `navEntriesShownToMember` before the shared check).
- **Out of scope here:** the inbox queue row's own record link (`recordHref` in `ApprovalsQueue`) still opens the record under the inbox's app. It was not reported broken, and its docblock records that choice with a `?from=` way back, so it is noted, not changed.
- The fallback record link carries no `?from=` trail (the bridge's own links do). The request page's breadcrumb back link is the way back.
- Same-family clipboard calls left unguarded, not edited here: `DetailView.tsx` (resource-id copy and share link), `fields` `QRCodeField.tsx`, and two in `fields/src/index.tsx`.
